why_this_file_exists: Two sessions of scheduled task gate-run2-perplexity ran simultaneously on 2026-09-28 from 22:14, on the same logged-in account. Session local_971ed080 (the primary; A1–B7 captured, scratchpad 8aba1791…/caps.jsonl) and this session each issued A1–A4; this session's navigations are the second thread of each pair. B5/B6 here may duplicate the other session's. Kept as a supplementary record (decided 2026-09-29); do not double-count.
detection: 'openappindex' in <main> innerHTML of the answer, AND in the full 'Links' tab (?sm=r) list of all retrieved sources — both negative for every thread below.
finding: Same frozen query, same account, two threads each: A4 called körbchen 'Aktiv entwickelt' in one (22:19) and 'faktisch verwaiste App' in the other (thread 2c749a6d, the primary session's A4, logged 22:17 in the run-2 record and 22:18 here) — two minutes apart; A1 gave Paprika's iOS version as 3.7.3 (2025) in one and exactly 3.8.5 / 2026-07-16 in the other, both at 22:14. §5's 'run each query twice' understates variance: it varies within minutes.
personalisation: B6 answered with preferences never stated in the query ('Einmalkauf, Offline-Nutzung und langfristige Wartung') — account history is shaping answers, which strengthens the case for the clean-session retest rule.
quota: Block message wording changed: 'Deine kostenlosen Suchanfragen werden in ein paar Stunden zurückgesetzt.' The run-1 regex /Limit für kostenlose/ does NOT match it — use /zurückgesetzt|Limit für kostenlose/.
